subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the location mentioned by the loudspeaker

740670401.text: We meet again. I made a bet with myself on whether it would be you who came.

740670403.text: Heh, I won, and I lost too.

740670406.text: Why would you do that using a loudspeaker? Wouldn't you be in trouble if Galvaryet caught you? Aren't you terrified of her?

740670407.text: Terrified of her? Why would I be? It's just a bit annoying when she catches you. But she spends most of her time in the administrative area. She doesn't get involved with issues in the production zone unless there's good reason to.

740670408.text: As for why I use a loudspeaker for things like this, naturally it's because it's way too boring here.

740670409.text: I think I get Teilhard now. He must be bored out of his mind, so he's always trying to find ways to entertain himself. In that sense, I'm just copying him.

740670410.text: You've got a friend like him, right? One who's always full of crazy ideas, sometimes making a ridiculous mess of things.

740670405.text: Good question, but an easy one to answer... It's because nobody here was willing to make such a boring wager with me.
